$media-ingest-flow.description: Drag-drop in the studio → file lands in media/ via /api/media/ingest → #ingest-dispatch classifyMediaFile derives kind (video / image / audio / unsupported) → routeIngest pairs (file-kind, project-kind|undefined) into the 12-cell matrix → dispatcher routes to the right composer or rejects + unlinks the upload. Scaffold-on-ingest is permitted only for video+undef and image+undef; audio cannot establish a project on its own. Spans the studio HTTP handler, #ingest-dispatch, and one of the three composers depending on the route.

ingest video into video project (compose-video target)
ingest single image into image project (compose-image target)
add-audio-clip target — register audio clip on audio track
on reject, unlink the just-uploaded file and respond 400

$rename-cascade-flow.description: One rename op cascades through media/, transcripts/, and project.atelier (assets, layers, timeline). Phase 1 stages every change in memory (load doc → apply rename walk → recompute timeline → scan artifacts for warnings) without touching disk. Phase 2 writes in order: media file → transcript (if present) → doc; on any mid-step failure the prior writes are reverse-rolled-back best-effort before the original error is rethrown. Triggered from either the studio HTTP endpoint or the MCP tool wrapper; both gate on ^valid-media-basename before entry, and both join straight into <projectDir>/media/<basename> so the basename guard is load-bearing.

steps.action: Phase 1 — load doc, applyMediaRenameToDoc, recomputeTimeline, scan artifacts
Phase 2 — rename transcript if present (rollback media on failure)
Phase 2 — write project.atelier (rollback transcript + media on failure)

$doc-create-flow.description: Sidebar "+ new doc" → NewDocDialog three-tile picker (video / image / carousel) with live slug preview → POST /api/project/:name/docs → handler runs ^valid-doc-name then createDoc → composeImageProject / composeVideoProject / composeCarouselProject builds the doc → file written under <projectDir>/<slug>.atelier → handler broadcasts {type:"doc:list:changed", projectName} on the bridge WS → every connected workspace-app sidebar refreshes its DOCUMENT / SLIDES / OTHER DOCS groups. When the carousel project is active and the slide toggle is on, createDoc also runs composeCarouselProject to append a SlideRef (with full cycle check).

steps.action: render "+ new doc" affordance on the DOCUMENT label row
collect kind + name (+ slide toggle), preview slug

$doc-delete-cascade-flow.description: Right-click on a sidebar doc row → context menu → Delete… → ConfirmDialog → DELETE /api/project/:name/docs?path=<rel> → handler gates ^valid-doc-name (on the basename) + ^manifest-doc-protected (isManifestDoc(decoded)) + ^doc-path-inside-project → deleteDoc walks every sibling project subdir in the workspace, removes matching SlideRef entries from any carousel manifest, collects dangling RefVisual layers into a report (NOT auto-removed per ~doc-dangling-refvisual-reported), and unlinks the doc → broadcast !doc-list-changed → sidebars refresh. If the currently-open doc in the bridge was the one deleted, the bridge falls back to the project manifest so the editor never lingers on a missing file.

steps.action: deleteDoc → workspace-wide SlideRef scrub + RefVisual dangling scan + unlink
refresh; bridge falls back to manifest if currentDoc was deleted
